package parse

import (
 \"strings\"
 \"testing\"
 \"github.com/gravitational/trace\"
 \"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
)

func TestNestedExpressions(t *testing.T) {
 expr,err:=NewExpression("'` pre{{regexp.replace(email.local(external.email), "''^([''^.]+).*", "$1")}}post `)
 require.NoError(t,err)
 vals,err:=expr.Interpolate(map[string][]string{"email":{"alice@example.com","bob.smith@example.com"}},func(ns,name string)error{require.Equal(t,"external",ns);require.Equal(t,"email",name);return nil})
 require.NoError(t,err)
 require.Equal(t,[]string{"prealicepost","prebobpost"},vals)
 expr,err=NewExpression(`{{regexp.replace("foo", "o", "a")}}`)
 require.NoError(t,err)
 vals,err=expr.Interpolate(nil)
 require.NoError(t,err)
 require.Equal(t,[]string{"faa"},vals)
}
func TestExpressionValidation(t *testing.T) {
 for _,in:=range []string{`{{internal}}`,`{{internal.foo.bar}}`,`{{internal.foo["bar"]}}`,`{{internal["foo"]["bar"]}}`,`{{unknown.foo}}`,`{{"asdf"}}`,`{{123}}`,`{{regexp.match("foo")}}`,`{{email.local(regexp.match("foo"))}}`,`{{regexp.replace(external.foo, external.pattern, "bar")}}`,`{{regexp.replace(external.foo, "x", external.replacement)}}`,`{{regexp.replace(external.foo, "x")}}`,`{{regexp.match(external.foo)}}`,`{{email.local("x", "y")}}`,`{{external.foo`}{
  _,err:=NewExpression(in);require.Error(t,err,in);require.True(t,trace.IsBadParameter(err),"%q: %v",in,err)
 }
 expr,err:=NewExpression(`{{internal.foo}}`);require.NoError(t,err)
 _,err=expr.Interpolate(map[string][]string{"foo":{"v"}},func(ns,name string)error{return trace.BadParameter("blocked %s.%s",ns,name)})
 require.True(t,trace.IsBadParameter(err))
 _,err=expr.Interpolate(nil);require.True(t,trace.IsNotFound(err));require.Contains(t,err.Error(),"internal.foo")
 expr,err=NewExpression(`prefix{{regexp.replace(external.foo, "z", "x")}}suffix`);require.NoError(t,err)
 _,err=expr.Interpolate(map[string][]string{"foo":{"abc"}});require.True(t,trace.IsNotFound(err))
 require.Contains(t,err.Error(),"no values")
 _,err=NewExpression("{{"+strings.Repeat("email.local(",101)+"external.foo"+strings.Repeat(")",101)+"}}")
 require.True(t,trace.IsBadParameter(err))
}
func TestMatcherAST(t *testing.T) {
 m,err:=NewMatcher(`pre{{regexp.not_match("''^bad$")}}post`);require.NoError(t,err)
 require.True(t,m.Match("pregoodpost"));require.False(t,m.Match("prebadpost"));require.False(t,m.Match("goodpost"))
 m,err=NewMatcher(`a*b`);require.NoError(t,err);require.True(t,m.Match("axxb"));require.False(t,m.Match("zaxxb"))
 for _,in:=range []string{`{{external.foo}}`,`{{regexp.match(external.foo)}}`,`{{regexp.match("x", "y")}}`,`{{regexp.match("[")}}`} {_,err:=NewMatcher(in);require.True(t,trace.IsBadParameter(err),"%s: %v",in,err)}
}
EOF
